subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should a Feishu owner run live WebSocket diagnostics for the current-release `im.message.receive_v1` delivery gap before any repair job is queued?
rationale: Source and dependency inspection prove the intended dispatcher wiring, but only a real Feishu tenant can show whether the message event is absent at the platform, SDK, parser, or OpenClaw routing boundary.

options.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
options.body: Use a Feishu app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted gateway/SDK logs for lifecycle and message events before selecting a fix path.

options.title: Treat as covered by the broader inbound issue
options.body: Keep work attached to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92595 only if maintainers decide the lifecycle-events-still-arrive detail is not distinct enough to track separately.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics
recommendation.body: Use a Feishu app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted gateway/SDK logs for lifecycle and message events before selecting a fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata routes Feishu/Lark channel ownership to this handle, and the needed proof is Feishu-plugin specific.
